reply_body: You turned off autopay in your UPI app and still saw the annual plan renew — that's not what should have happened, and I'm sorry for the trouble. Your subscription and the renewal on it will be reviewed by our billing team against your account records, and we'll also make sure nothing further is scheduled on it. Someone will come back to you on this shortly.
summary: User says autopay was disabled but annual plan renewed anyway; wants the renewal charge reversed and no further billing.
